Congresswoman Kat Cammack is an amazing woman and a wonderful friend.

It’s shameful that she’s having to share her side of this story like this, because a reporter published an abject lie about her ectopic pregnancy, but her strength and resilience in protecting innocent life is inspiring.

I am so sick of the rabidly pro-abortion media—that they continue to manipulate and twist real stories of real women and babies to push evil propaganda of death.


Congresswoman Kat Cammack (@RepKatCammack)
